svg.title: E-01 Electrical Feed Schematic - Tape Measure Satellite Yagi
svg.desc: Rev A independent dual-band electrical feed and DC checks derived from O3-O6 Rev L.
svg.text: FOR REVIEW - SOURCE O3-O6 REV L
2M-DE SPLIT DRIVEN ELEMENT | X = 13.500 FROM FRONT
8.500 INITIAL BLANK; FORM PER O5 SEC. 10; TUNE IN O8
REMOVE ANTENNA-END BNC ONLY AFTER O7 GATE
70-DE SPLIT DRIVEN ELEMENT | X = 18.500 FROM FRONT
REMOVE ANTENNA-END BNC ONLY AFTER O7 GATE
PIN -> SHELL, ONE 2 m HAIRPIN END DISCONNECTED
ALL CROSS-FEED CONDUCTOR PAIRS, EQUIPMENT DETACHED
2. CONNECT CENTER TO A; BRAID TO B.
3. WITH ONE 2 m HAIRPIN END FREE,
CLOSES THROUGH HAIRPIN; 70 cm STAYS OPEN.
A = CENTER LUG + ONE HALF; B = BRAID LUG + OTHER HALF. LEFT/RIGHT MAY REVERSE BEFORE ASSEMBLY IF LABELED.
EACH NODE: OWN #6-32 HARDWARE / LUG; 2 m ONLY ADDS ONE BARE HAIRPIN END. NO SCREW / LUG MAY BRIDGE THE GAP.
NO PASSIVE BNC TEE. BASELINE: TWO RADIOS / TWO FEEDS. FERRITES, REAR ROUTING, STRAIN RELIEF PER O5 SEC. 12.
1. SCHEMATIC ONLY; NOT TO SCALE. STEEL GAP IS NOT THE FEED-SCREW CENTER SPACING.
2. 2 m HAIRPIN IS A STARTING GEOMETRY; FINAL MATCH REQUIRES O8 RF MEASUREMENT.
3. THIS SHEET STATES EXPECTED RESULTS; NO AS-BUILT DC OR RF DATA ARE CLAIMED.
